bbbt.hud.title: Suggestions
bbbt.hud.no_model: No model loaded - using simple rules
bbbt.screen.settings.title: Brick by Brick Tab
bbbt.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns block suggestions on or off. Nothing is tracked or predicted while off.
bbbt.option.suggestionCount.tooltip: How many candidates to keep and cycle through with the next-suggestion key.
bbbt.option.confidenceThreshold.tooltip: Candidates the model is less sure about than this are hidden instead of shown as noise.
bbbt.option.refreshDelayTicks.tooltip: Ticks to wait after you move or place a block before recomputing. Higher values are calmer and cheaper.
bbbt.option.previewDepth.tooltip: How many placements ahead to preview. Later steps are guesses built on earlier guesses, so they get less reliable.
bbbt.option.showGhostBlocks.tooltip: Draw the suggested block in the world as a translucent preview.
bbbt.option.ghostLookOnly.tooltip: Show a ghost only in the empty cell you are aiming at, not a cloud of nearby candidates. Cycle still switches alternative blocks for that one cell.
bbbt.option.fastPlaceFromInventory.toolt: Right-click a ghost to move the matching block onto the hotbar with a vanilla inventory swap, then place it through the normal click. Nothing is spawned. If the block is not in your inventory the ghost is red.
bbbt.option.showHudList.tooltip: Show the list of current suggestions on the HUD.
bbbt.option.hudAnchor.tooltip: Where the suggestion list sits on the screen.
bbbt.option.ghostOpacity.tooltip: How solid the ghost block looks.
bbbt.option.showConfidence.tooltip: Display how sure the model is about each suggestion.
bbbt.option.showOutline.tooltip: Draw an outline around the suggested position so it reads clearly against busy backgrounds.
bbbt.option.trackOtherPlayers.tooltip: Use blocks placed by other players as context. They are never used for training and never sent anywhere.
bbbt.option.focusRegion.tooltip: When you bind the focus-corner keys, the model prefers already-placed blocks inside that box. It cannot see farther than 8 blocks from the last placement; this only chooses which of those nearby blocks get attention, for example the house you are mirroring rather than clutter next to it.
bbbt.option.bulkChangeThreshold.tooltip: Above this many block changes in one tick, only your own placements are trusted. Filters explosions, growing trees and world edits.
bbbt.option.loraEnabled.tooltip: Adapts the model to your style on this machine. Nothing leaves your computer.
bbbt.option.loraStrength.tooltip: How much your personal style overrides the base model. Zero disables it without forgetting what it learned.
bbbt.option.loraAutoTrain.tooltip: Run a short training pass in the background as you build.
bbbt.option.loraTrainEveryPlacements.too: Number of blocks you place between background training passes.
bbbt.option.loraScope.tooltip: One profile for every world, or a separate profile per world.
bbbt.option.resetPersonalisation.tooltip: Clears your personalisation profile and starts over from the base model.
bbbt.option.placementConsent.tooltip: Send anonymous relative block positions to help train the shared model.
bbbt.option.captionConsent.tooltip: Collect descriptions of your builds. Asked separately because descriptions can contain text you wrote.
bbbt.option.captionAutoGenerate.tooltip: Write descriptions from the shape and materials alone. Uses no text you typed.
bbbt.option.captionHarvestSigns.tooltip: Use text from signs standing next to a build as its description. Off by default, since signs can say anything.
bbbt.option.captionCollectLocally.toolti: Save build descriptions to disk even if you do not share them. Turn this off to stop collecting them at all.
bbbt.option.deleteData.tooltip: Removes everything collected on this machine, including anything waiting to be uploaded.
bbbt.option.installId.tooltip: Quote this if you ever want your contributed data removed. It is a random number, not tied to your account.
bbbt.option.autoPlaceEnabled.tooltip: Lets the accept key place the suggested block directly. Off by default: suggestions are meant to be visual.
bbbt.option.debugOverlay.tooltip: Shows timings, model source and context size. Enable this in config.json.
bbbt.option.reloadModel.tooltip: Re-reads the weights and palette from disk, and checks the server for a newer catalog model.
bbbt.option.autoUpdateModel.tooltip: Download the latest published weights from the same host as building-data upload. Off keeps whatever is already on disk.
bbbt.consent.title: Brick by Brick Tab
bbbt.consent.intro: This mod works entirely on your machine. Before anything is shared, it needs your answer to two separate questions.
bbbt.consent.placement.title: 1. Building data
bbbt.consent.placement.body: Positions of blocks you place, relative to each other, plus their names. No coordinates, no world or server name, no account, no chat. Used to train the shared suggestion model.
bbbt.consent.caption.title: 2. Build descriptions
bbbt.consent.caption.body: Short descriptions of finished builds, so a future model can build from a written request. Some are written automatically from the shape; others are ones you type yourself. Asked separately because your own words are involved.
bbbt.consent.independent: These are independent. Saying yes to one does not imply the other.
bbbt.consent.reversible: You can change either answer at any time in the settings, and deleting your data deletes what was already collected.
bbbt.annotate.title: Describe this build
bbbt.annotate.hint: In your own words, e.g. "small oak cabin with a porch".
bbbt.annotate.rejected: That description could not be used.
bbbt.annotate.disabled: Turn on build descriptions in the settings first.
bbbt.message.auto_place_off: Placing blocks for you is turned off in the settings
bbbt.message.fast_place_no_block: That block is not in your inventory
bbbt.message.focus.disabled: Focus region is turned off in the settings
